channel.title: Yaroslav Korets — Writing
channel.description: Field notes on AI systems in production.

item.title: The Operational Last Mile: Why AI Demos Die Before Production
item.dc:creator: Yaroslav Korets
item.description: A production AI system needs source data, validation, approval gates, and an audit trail built around how a product or service is delivered.

item.title: Marco: Why an Outbound AI Agent Starts With Infrastructure
item.dc:creator: Yaroslav Korets
item.description: Marco is an outbound AI agent that begins with sender health, deliverability gates, and signals before it writes a message.

item.title: Hunter: AI Needs Rules, Approval Gates, and Logs
item.dc:creator: Yaroslav Korets
item.description: Hunter runs persistent PPC operations across Google and Microsoft Ads, but meaningful changes stay governed by written rules and human approval.

item.title: Oscar: Why the Dashboard Is Becoming the Wrong Interface
item.dc:creator: Yaroslav Korets
item.description: Oscar is a self-hosted YouTube operations agent that turns analytics, SEO, captions, and channel tools into a plain-language interface.

item.title: InspectPilot: Contractor Reputation vs. the Public Record
item.dc:creator: Yaroslav Korets
item.description: InspectPilot pairs inspection scheduling with a compliance engine built on roughly 11 million Los Angeles inspection records over 13 years.

item.title: AI Changed the Build-vs.-Buy Line
item.dc:creator: Yaroslav Korets
item.description: A field note on replacing selected SaaS tools with self-hosted systems, where ownership saves money, and where it creates new operating costs.

item.title: Behind the Watt: How to Use AI Without Asking Anyone to Trust It
item.dc:creator: Yaroslav Korets
item.description: Behind the Watt is an open evidence database that uses AI to extract claims from public records while preserving source-level provenance and human approval.

item.title: The Operating Principle: Persistence, Human Approval, Audit Logs
item.dc:creator: Yaroslav Korets
item.description: A production pattern for AI systems: let software handle persistence and volume, keep consequential decisions with people, and log every action.
